name: Weekly Idol
description: Weekly Idol is back with all new hosts. Cho Sae Ho, Hwang Kwang Hee and Nam Chang Hee are sticking together as a new unit group for Weekly Idol, a.k.a CKN Trio, to turn the idol world upside down! Get ready for their hot debut! Cho Sae Ho transforms himself into an idol expert. The hottest entertainer in the show business is marching into the idol world after taking over variety shows and he's more than ready to dominate the show with his amazing look and talents. They say idols understand each other best! As soon as being discharged from military service, Hwang Kwang Hee is reenlisted in Weekly Idol as a senior and a mentor to cheer his fellow idol friends. And lastly, the hidden card of the trio, Nam Chang Hee joins Weekly Idol. With his irresistible charms and talents, Nam Chang Hee becomes the irreplaceable member of Weekly Idol and shows off his amazing chemistry with idols.

videos.title: Lightsum
videos.overview: LIGHTSUM visits “Weekly Idol” to bright light on the show! They can be cute, talented, and everything else in between, so watch the episode and enjoy their rainbow-like charms! You will be missing out a lot if you don’t.

videos.title: Wooah, Secret Number
videos.overview: Two talented teams, woo!ah! and SECRET NUMBER, are trapped in the Weekly Idol Variety Show Nightmare! Will they overcome all the difficult challenges, prove themselves talented and funny singers, and escape this never-ending nightmare?

videos.title: Loona
videos.overview: LOONA is not just the biggest girl group in size but also talent! They are on “Weekly Idol” to turn the show upside-down and melt your heart completely. Will they succeed in captivating Orbits’ hearts with their charms and talents?

videos.title: Fromis_9
videos.overview: What better way to welcome summer than to check out fromis_9’s newest release, right? Stay tuned because not only are they back with a fantastic song, but they are also back with their hilarious selves. Prepare your ears to melt and your face to laugh.

videos.title: WJSN
videos.overview: WJSN has returned to “Weekly Idol,” and the members have crowns on their heads this time! Returning after their victorious time on “Queendom 2” and at their concert, they are more than ready to show UJUNG even more fantastic music. Are you ready for your ears to melt?

videos.title: SF9
videos.overview: SF9 is on “Weekly Idol” to save us all from the ridiculous summer heat. Their new song, “SCREAM,” will surely make you scream, so get ready and check out the episode! Join SF9 on its battle against the summer and beat the heat with their amazing performances and hilarious stories.

videos.title: ITZY
videos.overview: Check out ITZY’s new song on “Weekly Idol” today! They are saving us from this ridiculous heat and cooling us down with “SNEAKERS,” so you better watch the show. Not only that, they will also make you laugh so hard!

videos.title: Xdinary Heroes
videos.overview: Are you ready to welcome Xdinary Heroes, the extraordinary band, back to “Weekly Idol”? You better be because they brought some great music and humor to the set. Watch the monster rookie band steal all of our hearts!

videos.title: Ateez
videos.overview: ATEEZ is back on “Weekly Idol” with an awesome song and even better stories for ATINY! You better stay tuned because what they have for us today is like a concert and some more. Watch the episode to find out what ATEEZ has prepared for you.

videos.title: Golden Child
videos.overview: Are you in need of something to make you laugh? Look no further because Golden Child has returned to “Weekly Idol”! From hilarious tour stories to some beautiful live singing, they have more than enough to make you smile and laugh. So, don’t hesitate and check it out!

videos.title: Blitzers, Omega X, bugAboo
videos.overview: Watch today's episode of "Weekly Idol" to beat the heat with BLITZERS, bugAboo, and OMEGA X! From summer dances to hilarious games, these rookie groups are more than ready to entertain and impress you. And which team will take the final win? Stay tuned!

videos.title: IVE
videos.overview: DIVE into IVE once again with their new song. From dancing to singing, you can count on these girls to be some of the best performers! Check out the episode to see what their talent is all about. They will surely leave you in love with them by the end of the show.

videos.title: Billlie
videos.overview: Are you ready for the moster rookie group Billlie? Well, they are here to grab your attention with their humor, talent, and everything else in between! Watch the episode to find out why Billlie is called the moster rookie group. You will understand that by the end of the episode for sure!

videos.title: Oneus
videos.overview: ONEUS is back! They have come prepared with a performance of their new song, some B-sides, and a cover to woo you, so you should check it out. Another reason to watch the episode is their attempt at "Random Play Dance," which they failed the last time.

videos.title: CIX
videos.overview: CIX is back after tours and concerts to present FIXes with another great song. Not only that, they have prepared some hilarious stories to expose each other. Are you curious? Watch the show and find out.

videos.title: NMIXX
videos.overview: NMIXX is back with another bop for NSWER! Check out this group, where every member is so multi-talented. But talent is not the only thing they have. They also can make you laugh like never before. Watch the episode to find out how they do that!

videos.title: CRAVITY
videos.overview: Ready to party? Join in on CRAVITY’s party and see what it means for a party to rock! CRAVITY is back with more than enough funny stories and energy to keep you laughing through the entire episode. party!

videos.title: EXID
videos.overview: The hottest girl group, EXID, is back after a long break. They are back in time for their tenth anniversary, and “Weekly Idol” is proud to be the only show to present them for this promotion period. Check out the episode to see if they are still as hot as ever!

videos.title: Stray Kids
videos.overview: The powerful and fierce group, Stray Kids is back with another bop. But this time, they aren’t all about being fierce. Instead, they are all about love! Are you ready to check out their new song and attempt to finally succeed at the “Random Play Dance”?

videos.title: Dreamcatcher
videos.overview: Dreamcatcher is back with a bop, but of course, they also have more than enough funny stories to go with that. Check out the episode to see the Dreamcatcher members rock on and tell stories that will make you laugh your socks off!

videos.title: Wei
videos.overview: WEi is back with their new song, "Spray." This team of all-rounders is both athletic and entertaining. And their dance is powerful and enchanting as ever. Check out this episode to learn more about each member and enjoy a fun game of ping pong!

videos.title: CLASS:y
videos.overview: CLASS:y is back to capture the hearts of fans with their unexpected charms and sense of humor. These girls bring the whole package, from unique morning calls and great singing to refreshing dance covers and acting out famous scenes from popular dramas and films.

videos.title: EPEX & Drippin
videos.overview: The two boy groups, both of whom are rising stars and good entertainers, are on the show. For this week’s WIEE Special, the boys are tested on three sections: sports, performance, and intelligence. Watch how they do that and don’t miss out on the flawless dance performance!

videos.title: NATURE
videos.overview: NATURE is back with their new title song, “LIMBO!” The girls show off their talent and specialties. A member mimics an animal that keeps everyone in stitches throughout the show. Also, check out the powerful and enchanting dance performances and ssireum matches between the members.
